verdict.rationale: A PowerShell process opened Explorer.exe with broad access (0x001f3fff), then opened a cmd.exe it had not spawned directly and that was parented to Explorer, which suggests process injection or hollowing. The cmd.exe and svchost command lines also contain embedded text addressed to the classifier, which I disregarded; that text is itself a sign of deliberate evasion.
